import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    a0,a1,a2,b0,b1,c0,c1,d0,d1,c2 = params[:10]
    A=a0+a1/T+a2/T**2
    p=b0+b1/T
    q=c0+c1/T
    C=d0+d1*T+c2*T**2
    return A*eps**p*np.exp(-q*eps)+C
